Spy 75 - Projection of only 270mm

Basins for Small Bathrooms

In small spaces, it's crucial to reduce the depth or 'projection' of bathroom basins.

Choosing basins with a more shallow depth allows you to maximize floor space so look for basins that are less then 400mm in depth (the distance from the front to back if you were standing in front of it).

Add functionality with shelf space or attach a towel rail in wall hung settings to really get the most out of your basin configuration.

In-Wall Cisterns & Toilets

In-wall cisterns paired with wall-hung or wall-faced toilets offer the ultimate space-saving solution for modern bathrooms.

By concealing the cistern within the wall, valuable floor space is reclaimed, creating a sleek and minimalist aesthetic.

This configuration not only maximizes visual space but also enhances functionality by eliminating bulky external components.
